## This is the code prepared for the computational and spatial analysis part of the paper
This part of the script includes the quality control and filtering of the data.

#Samples
We have got 6 samples in total. Always a pair of two samples from the same patient. The blocks were classified as either high_PNI, no_PNI or noandhigh_PNI. For each of these we retained all spots on the slide (14336 per sample).

#===================================================================
# WHAT THIS SCRIPT PRODUCES
#===================================================================
# This is Step 0 of the whole pipeline -- the raw QC/filtering that
# everything else (Integrated_NMF.rds, etc.) is ultimately built on top
# of, produced by a separate downstream integration/NMF script not
# shown here.
#
# Processed (processed/):
#   - PNI_SPE_QC.rds
#       THE MAIN OUTPUT. QC-passing, in-tissue spots only, library-size
#       normalized (logNormCounts). Everything downstream in the
#       pipeline is ultimately derived from this object.
#
# The panels of this script are Figure S1A-G of the manuscript:
#   A  UMI counts per sample          E  HBB fraction
#   B  detected genes per sample      F  spatial QC pass/fail coverage
#   C  UMI vs detected genes          G  spot retention
#   D  mitochondrial fraction
# Anything named "exploratory_" is not in the manuscript.
#
# Tables (output/01_QC_filtering/tables/):
#   - sample_composition.csv
#       Patient x Type spot counts (the console table() output, saved).
#   - retention_summary.csv
#       Per-sample spot counts by status (Off_tissue / Failed_QC /
#       Retained) -- backs Panel G below.
#
# Figures (output/01_QC_filtering/figures/):
#   - exploratory_QC_overview_early.pdf
#       Early QC overview (UMI/gene violin + scatter), before the final
#       panel styling below -- kept for reference.
#   - FigureS1_panels_A-E.pdf
#       Panels A-E combined (UMI, genes, UMI-vs-genes scatter,
#       mito %, HBB %).
#   - FigureS1F_spatial.png
#       Panel F: spatial QC pass/fail coverage, patient x context grid.
#   - FigureS1G_retention.pdf
#       Panel G: spot retention bar chart.
#   - FigureS1_full_summary.pdf
#       All panels (A-G) combined, everything rasterized uniformly --
#       simplest, most robust option given repeated vector-rendering
#       issues with this many points.
#   - FigureS1_full_summary_A4_portrait.pdf /
#     FigureS1_full_summary_A4_landscape.pdf
#       Same full panel, but only the dense point-cloud panels (C, F)
#       rasterized -- everything else stays vector/editable. Two page
#       orientations for layout flexibility.
#   - FigureS1<A-G>_*.pdf/.png
#       Every individual panel exported separately, for placing into
#       a custom supplementary figure layout by hand.
#
# BUGFIXES (this pass):
#   - ggsave("../figures/S1_G", ...) had NO FILE EXTENSION -- ggsave()
#     cannot infer the output format without one; this would either
#     error or silently produce a malformed file. Now saved as
#     exploratory_retention_summary_duplicate.pdf.
#   - The rasterized-partial summary was saved TWICE to the exact same
#     filename (FigureS1_full_summary_A4_portrait.pdf), once in
#     A4 portrait dimensions and once in A4 landscape -- the second
#     call silently overwrote the first. Now two distinct filenames
#     (_A4_portrait / _A4_landscape).
#===================================================================

```{r}
library(patchwork)
library(SpatialExperiment)
library(scuttle)
library(scran)
library(scater)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggspavis)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size=14))

# ---- 0. Directory structure -------------------------------------------
# Paths are relative to the project folder (the one containing input/).
# Run from there, or from scripts/ -- this moves up one level if needed.
if (basename(getwd()) == "scripts") setwd("..")
if (!dir.exists("input"))
  stop("Run this script from the project folder (the one containing input/).")

PROJECT_DIR   <- "."
INPUT_DIR     <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "input")
PROCESSED_DIR <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "processed")
SCRIPTS_DIR   <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "scripts")

ANALYSIS_NAME <- "01_QC_filtering"
TABLES_DIR    <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "output", ANALYSIS_NAME, "tables")
FIGURES_DIR   <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "output", ANALYSIS_NAME, "figures")
dir.create(PROCESSED_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(TABLES_DIR,    recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(FIGURES_DIR,   recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# NOTE: place general_functions.R into scripts/
# before running.
source(file.path(SCRIPTS_DIR, "general_functions.R"))

# Load Data
# NOTE: place PNI_SPE.rds (the raw, pre-QC SpatialExperiment object)
# into input/ before running.
spe <- readRDS(file.path(INPUT_DIR, "PNI_SPE.rds"))
# Shuffle for plotting
set.seed(42)
spe <- spe[,sample(1:ncol(spe),ncol(spe))]
# Some Formatting
rownames(spe) <- uniquifyFeatureNames(rownames(spe), rowData(spe)$symbol)
spe$patient_id <- unlist(lapply(strsplit(spe$sample_id,"bl"), function(X) X[[1]]))
spe$type <- unlist(lapply(strsplit(spe$sample_id,"_"), function(X) X[[2]]))
# Calculate QC
mtgen <- grepl("^MT-",rownames(spe))
hbbgn <- grepl("^HBB$",rownames(spe))
spe <- addPerCellQC(spe,subsets=list("Mito"=mtgen,"HBB"=hbbgn))

sample_composition <- as.data.frame(table("Patient" = spe$patient_id, "Type" = spe$type))
write.csv(sample_composition, file.path(TABLES_DIR, "sample_composition.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
print(table("Patient" = spe$patient_id, "Type" = spe$type))
```
# Spots in tissue
```{r}
spe$in_tissue <- factor(spe$in_tissue)
levels(spe$in_tissue) <- c("no","yes")
# The areas specified below are actually fatty tissue (verified by H&E images)
spe$in_tissue[spe$sample_id=="54703bl28_highPNI" & spe$array_row > 100] <- "yes"
spe$in_tissue[spe$sample_id=="54703bl28_highPNI" & spe$array_col < 100] <- "yes"
spe$in_tissue[spe$sample_id=="6249bl18_noPNIandhighPNI" & spe$array_row > 95] <- "yes"
spe$in_tissue[spe$sample_id=="6249bl18_noPNIandhighPNI" & spe$array_row < 38] <- "yes"
spe$in_tissue[spe$sample_id=="6249bl23_noPNI" & spe$array_row > 90 & spe$array_col > 130] <- "yes"

# Quality control visualization
plotVisium(spe[,spe$in_tissue=="yes"], y_coord='pxl_row_in_fullres', x_coord='pxl_col_in_fullres', spots=TRUE, image=FALSE)
```

# Transcriptomics quality control
We need to validate the UMI and gene count of our data:
```{r}
spe$sample_label <- factor(spe$sample_id,
                        levels = c("70865bl15_highPNI", "6249bl18_noPNIandhighPNI", "70865bl5_noPNI","54703bl38_noPNI","54703bl28_highPNI",  "6249bl23_noPNI"),
                        labels = c("P3-Diseased", "P2-Diseased", "P3-Adjacent","P1-Adjacent","P1-Diseased", "P2-Adjacent"))
p0 <- ggcells(spe, aes(x=sample_label,y=sum,fill=in_tissue)) +
    geom_violin(draw_quantiles=0.75,scale="width") +
    ylab("UMIs") +
    scale_y_log10() +
    theme(legend.position="none")

p1 <- ggcells(spe, aes(x=sample_label,y=detected,fill=in_tissue)) +
    geom_violin(draw_quantiles=0.75,scale="width") +
    ylab("Number of Genes") +
    theme(legend.position="bottom", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

p2 <- ggcells(spe, aes(x=sum,y=detected,color=patient_id)) +
    geom_point(size=0.1,alpha=.3) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    scale_y_log10() +
    ylab("Number of Genes detected") +
    xlab("UMIs") +
    theme(legend.position="none") +
    facet_wrap(~in_tissue)

ptch <- (p0) / (p1 + p2)
ptch + plot_annotation(title="Quality Overview of ST")
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "exploratory_QC_overview_early.pdf"), ptch, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```
**Definition of low quality**
We use the standard definition of 3 MADs away from the median (log space) only considering the spots within the tissue. We do this for both genes detected and UMI counts.
```{r}
sumqcpass <- !(isOutlier(spe$sum, subset=spe$in_tissue=="yes", log=TRUE, nmads=3, batch=spe$sample_id, type="lower"))
gdqcpass <- spe$detected > 500
spe$QCPass <- sumqcpass & gdqcpass
# Quality control visualization
plotVisium(spe[,spe$in_tissue=="yes"], y_coord='pxl_row_in_fullres', x_coord='pxl_col_in_fullres', spots=TRUE, image=FALSE,fill="QCPass")
```
**Mitochondrial Fraction**
We want to check the Mitochondrial fraction for further filtering. The only ones with high fractions are the ones that have very few counts, primarily from the one sample with a lot of adipose tissue. Therefore, we do not need to filter further.

```{r}
p0 <- ggcells(spe, aes(x=sample_id,y=subsets_Mito_percent,fill=in_tissue)) +
  geom_violin(draw_quantiles=0.5,scale="width") +
  geom_jitter(size=.2,alpha=0.1) +
  ylab("[%] Mitochondrial") +
  theme(legend.position="none")
p1 <- ggcells(spe, aes(x=sum,y=subsets_Mito_percent,color=in_tissue)) +
  geom_point(size=0.2,alpha=.4) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  xlab("UMIs") +
  ylab("[%] Mitochondrial") +
  theme(legend.position="none")
p0 + p1
```
**Hemoglobin**
We also checked spots that have primarily hemoglobin.
```{r}
p0 <- ggcells(spe, aes(x=sample_id,y=subsets_HBB_percent,fill=in_tissue)) +
  geom_violin(draw_quantiles=0.5,scale="width") +
  geom_jitter(size=.2,alpha=0.1) +
  ylab("[%] HBB") +
  theme(legend.position="none")
p1 <- ggcells(spe, aes(x=sum,y=subsets_HBB_percent,color=in_tissue)) +
  geom_point(size=0.2,alpha=.4) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  xlab("UMIs") +
  ylab("[%] HBB") +
  theme(legend.position="none")
p0 + p1
```

#Gene Filtering
We only remove genes with less than 100 counts across the entire dataset.
```{r}
rm <- rowSums(counts(spe)) < 100
spe <- spe[!rm,]
```

```{r}
library(magrittr)
#========================================================
# Sample labelling -- ordered by patient, then context (Adjacent before
# Diseased within each patient). This REPLACES the sample_label factor
# defined earlier in the "Transcriptomics quality control" section --
# p0/p1/p2 are also redefined below using this new labeling, so the
# panels actually saved to disk use this ordering, not the earlier one.
#========================================================
spe$sample_label <- factor(spe$sample_id,
                        levels = c("54703bl38_noPNI", "54703bl28_highPNI",
                                  "6249bl23_noPNI", "6249bl18_noPNIandhighPNI",
                                  "70865bl5_noPNI", "70865bl15_highPNI"),
                        labels = c("P1-Adjacent", "P1-Diseased",
                                  "P2-Adjacent", "P2-Diseased",
                                  "P3-Adjacent", "P3-Diseased"))

spe$patient_label <- factor(sub("-.*", "", as.character(spe$sample_label)),
                            levels = c("P1", "P2", "P3"))
spe$context_label <- factor(sub(".*-", "", as.character(spe$sample_label)),
                            levels = c("Adjacent", "Diseased"))

# Sanity check
print(table(spe$sample_label, spe$patient_label, spe$context_label))

#========================================================
# Reusable theme fix: white background + explicitly preserved axes
# (fixes ggcells axis elements being dropped when panel.background is
# overridden)
#========================================================
white_bg_with_axes <- theme(
  panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
  plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
  axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
  axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
  axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
  axis.title = element_text(color = "black")
)

#========================================================
# Panel A: UMI counts per sample
#========================================================
p0 <- ggcells(spe, aes(x = sample_label, y = sum, fill = in_tissue)) +
    geom_violin(draw_quantiles = 0.75, scale = "width") +
    ylab("UMIs") +
    scale_y_log10() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    white_bg_with_axes

#========================================================
# Panel B: Detected genes per sample
#========================================================
p1 <- ggcells(spe, aes(x = sample_label, y = detected, fill = in_tissue)) +
    geom_violin(draw_quantiles = 0.75, scale = "width") +
    ylab("Number of Genes") +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    white_bg_with_axes

#========================================================
# Panel C: UMI vs detected genes scatter, by patient, faceted by in_tissue
#========================================================
p2 <- ggcells(spe, aes(x = sum, y = detected, color = patient_label)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.1, alpha = .3) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    scale_y_log10() +
    ylab("Number of Genes detected") +
    xlab("UMIs") +
    labs(color = "Patient") +
    theme(legend.position = "right") +
    facet_wrap(~in_tissue) +
    white_bg_with_axes

#========================================================
# Panel D: Mitochondrial fraction
#========================================================
p_mito <- ggcells(spe, aes(x = sample_label, y = subsets_Mito_percent, fill = in_tissue)) +
  geom_violin(draw_quantiles = 0.5, scale = "width") +
  geom_jitter(size = .2, alpha = 0.1) +
  ylab("[%] Mitochondrial") +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  white_bg_with_axes

#========================================================
# Panel E: HBB fraction
#========================================================
p_hbb <- ggcells(spe, aes(x = sample_label, y = subsets_HBB_percent, fill = in_tissue)) +
  geom_violin(draw_quantiles = 0.5, scale = "width") +
  geom_jitter(size = .2, alpha = 0.1) +
  ylab("[%] HBB") +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  white_bg_with_axes

#========================================================
# Panel F: Spatial QC pass/fail coverage, patients x context grid
#========================================================
p_spatial_qc <- ggcells(spe[, spe$in_tissue == "yes"],
                        aes(x = array_col, y = -array_row, color = QCPass)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.4) +
  facet_grid(context_label ~ patient_label) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#2a78d6", `FALSE` = "#D55E00")) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(color = "QC Pass", title = "Spatial distribution of QC-passing spots") +
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA))

#========================================================
# Panel G: Retained spot counts
#========================================================
retention_df <- as.data.frame(colData(spe)) %>%
  group_by(sample_label) %>%
  summarise(
    Off_tissue = sum(in_tissue == "no"),
    Failed_QC = sum(in_tissue == "yes" & !QCPass, na.rm = TRUE),
    Retained = sum(in_tissue == "yes" & QCPass, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(c(Off_tissue, Failed_QC, Retained), names_to = "Status", values_to = "n_spots") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Status = factor(Status, levels = c("Off_tissue", "Failed_QC", "Retained")))

write.csv(retention_df, file.path(TABLES_DIR, "retention_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

p_retention <- ggplot(retention_df, aes(x = sample_label, y = n_spots, fill = Status)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Off_tissue" = "grey85", "Failed_QC" = "#D55E00", "Retained" = "#2a78d6")) +
  labs(y = "Number of spots (of 14,336 total)", x = NULL, title = "Spot filtering summary") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "bottom") +
  white_bg_with_axes


#========================================================
# Final assembly -- ONE build, no duplication
#========================================================
#========================================================
# File 1: Panels A-E (violin plots + UMI/gene scatter + mito/HBB)
#========================================================
panels_AE <- (p0 | p1) / p2 / (p_mito | p_hbb) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Quality Overview of ST", tag_levels = "A") +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1, 1))

ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "FigureS1_panels_A-E.pdf"), panels_AE, width = 14, height = 14, dpi = 300)

#========================================================
# File 2: Panel F (spatial QC coverage) -- saved as PNG to avoid the
# vector-object-count problem in Illustrator
#========================================================
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "FigureS1F_spatial.png"), p_spatial_qc,
      width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 600, bg = "white")

#========================================================
# File 3: Panel G (retention bar chart) -- lightweight, vector PDF fine
#========================================================
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "FigureS1G_retention.pdf"), p_retention,
      width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300)

#========================================================
# Rasterize everything uniformly -- simplest, most robust option for
# this supplementary figure given repeated vector-rendering issues
#========================================================
library(ggrastr)

p0_r <- ggrastr::rasterise(p0, dpi = 600)
p1_r <- ggrastr::rasterise(p1, dpi = 600)
p2_r <- ggrastr::rasterise(p2, dpi = 600)
p_mito_r <- ggrastr::rasterise(p_mito, dpi = 600)
p_hbb_r <- ggrastr::rasterise(p_hbb, dpi = 600)
p_spatial_qc_r <- ggrastr::rasterise(p_spatial_qc, dpi = 600)
p_retention_r <- ggrastr::rasterise(p_retention, dpi = 600)

qc_full_panel <- (p0_r | p1_r) / p2_r / (p_mito_r | p_hbb_r) / (p_spatial_qc_r | p_retention_r) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Quality Overview of ST", tag_levels = "A") +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1, 1, 1.3))

ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "FigureS1_full_summary.pdf"), qc_full_panel, width = 14, height = 20, dpi = 300)

cat("File size:", file.info(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "FigureS1_full_summary.pdf"))$size / 1e6, "MB\n")

library(ggrastr)

# ---- Only rasterize the two panels with per-spot point density -----------
p2_r <- ggrastr::rasterise(p2, dpi = 600)
p_spatial_qc_r <- ggrastr::rasterise(p_spatial_qc, dpi = 600)

# ---- Everything else stays fully vector and editable -----------------------
# p0, p1, p_mito, p_hbb, p_retention are all summary shapes (violins, bars)
# with only a handful of objects each -- no need to rasterize these

qc_full_panel <- (p0 | p1) / p2_r / (p_mito | p_hbb) / (p_spatial_qc_r | p_retention) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Quality Overview of ST", tag_levels = "A") +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1, 1, 1.3))

# BUGFIX: previously both saved under the identical filename
# "FigureS1_full_summary_A4_portrait.pdf" -- the landscape save
# silently overwrote the portrait one. Now two distinct filenames.
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "FigureS1_full_summary_A4_portrait.pdf"), qc_full_panel,
      width = 8.27, height = 11.69, units = "in", dpi = 300)

ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "FigureS1_full_summary_A4_landscape.pdf"), qc_full_panel,
      width = 11.69, height = 8.27, units = "in", dpi = 300)
cat("File size:", file.info(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "FigureS1_full_summary.pdf"))$size / 1e6, "MB\n")

# ---- Panels D and E: rasterize ONLY the point/jitter layer, keep
# axes/violin outlines/text as editable vector ------------------------------
p_mito_r <- ggrastr::rasterise(p_mito, layers = "Point", dpi = 600)
p_hbb_r  <- ggrastr::rasterise(p_hbb,  layers = "Point", dpi = 600)

ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "FigureS1D_mito_rasterised.pdf"), p_mito_r, width = 6, height = 4)
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "FigureS1E_hbb_rasterised.pdf"), p_hbb_r, width = 6, height = 4)

ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "FigureS1A_umi.pdf"), p0, width = 6, height = 4)
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "FigureS1B_genes.pdf"), p1, width = 6, height = 4)
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "FigureS1C_scatter.pdf"), p2, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)  # PNG, since it's dense
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "FigureS1D_mito.pdf"), p_mito, width = 6, height = 4)
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "FigureS1E_hbb.pdf"), p_hbb, width = 6, height = 4)
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "FigureS1F_spatial_lowres.png"), p_spatial_qc, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)  # PNG
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "FigureS1G_retention_single.pdf"), p_retention, width = 6, height = 4)

```

```{r}
# NOTE: this recomputes retention_df/p_retention identically to the
# "Panel G" block above -- kept here only because the original script
# used this second copy to save under a different filename
# (BUGFIX: previously "S1_G" with no file extension). If you don't need
# a separately-named copy of Panel G, this whole chunk can be deleted
# and downstream code can just reuse p_retention from above.
retention_df <- as.data.frame(colData(spe)) %>%
  group_by(sample_label) %>%
  summarise(
    Off_tissue = sum(in_tissue == "no"),
    Failed_QC = sum(in_tissue == "yes" & !QCPass, na.rm = TRUE),
    Retained = sum(in_tissue == "yes" & QCPass, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(c(Off_tissue, Failed_QC, Retained), names_to = "Status", values_to = "n_spots") %>%
  mutate(Status = factor(Status, levels = c("Off_tissue", "Failed_QC", "Retained")))

p_retention <- ggplot(retention_df, aes(x = sample_label, y = n_spots, fill = Status)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Off_tissue" = "grey85", "Failed_QC" = "#D55E00", "Retained" = "#2a78d6")) +
  labs(y = "Number of spots (of 14,336 total)", x = NULL, title = "Spot filtering summary") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "bottom") +
  white_bg_with_axes

print(p_retention)
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "exploratory_retention_summary_duplicate.pdf"), p_retention, width = 14, height = 20, dpi = 300)
```

**Normalization and Save**
We keep only QC Pass spots and spots in the tissue, lib size normalize and save.
```{r}
spe <- spe[,spe$QCPass & spe$in_tissue=="yes"]
spe <- logNormCounts(spe)
saveRDS(spe, file.path(PROCESSED_DIR, "PNI_SPE_QC.rds"))
cat("Saved QC'd SPE object to:", file.path(PROCESSED_DIR, "PNI_SPE_QC.rds"), "\n")
```
